decisions.reason: Report identifies the same workspace-files insert row duplicated by bundle patch and manual profile-patch row, grounds it in boot-crash-log.txt (EntryGroup.update, duplicate loader entry id, cordis:include apply) and both excerpts, and explicitly states the fatal not-merge semantics: loader aborts the whole boot rather than overriding or skipping.

Report lays out the three operations (config-by-id safe, insert of unshipped id safe, insert of bundle-shipped id fatal), classifies the manual row as the fatal third case, and cites web-app-patch-excerpt.txt L110-111 workspace-files row as proof the bundle already provides it.

Report prescribes deleting the entire manual workspace-files insert block from the profile cordis.patch.yml only, leaving the bundle patch untouched, after which boot succeeds; no bundle or plugin edits suggested for the fix.

Report explicitly states the workspace-files plugin code is not at fault — it never loads because the loader fails first — and that no plugin-side change can resolve the boot failure since the defect is in composition authoring.

Report gives both halves: author must grep/inspect the installed bundle cordis.patch.yml for the id before hand-adding a row, and the host should print an actionable boot error naming both colliding source paths/lines plus which row to delete (with optional pre-validation).
